episode_summary: In this episode, Frances Katzen discusses the impact of the pietta tear tax on the New York real estate market and the importance of having a strong opinion in the industry. She shares insights on building a personal brand through media appearances and creating effective market reports. Frances also draws parallels between the discipline required in ballet and real estate, emphasizing consistency and presence as keys to success.
